newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line plans more large format stores.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line plans more large format stores.

text.p: Specialty retailer Finish Line Inc said Monday it plans to add three to five more "large format" stores over the next 12 months. Three currently exist.

Finish Line completed in June 1996 1.3 million share offering and raised proceeds of about $33.5 million. Proceeds are being used to strengthen the company's balance sheet, to eliminate bank debt and to continue new store growth plans.

Earlier, the specialty retailer reported earnings for its fiscal second quarter ended August 31, 1996 rose 94 percent from a year earlier to $6.3 million or $0.54 a share. Net sales increased forty-one percent to $91 million.
The retailer attributed the increase in earnings and sales to improved product margins and reduced expenses.

Merchandise inventories were $83.0 million at August 31, 1996 compared to $76.1 million at February 29, 1996. On a per square foot basis, merchandise inventories at August 31, 1996 fell eight percent from the same time last year and were four percent lower than at fiscal year end, February 29, 1996. Lower inventory levels reflect the company's stated goals to increase inventory turns and reduce aged inventory, it said.
Finish Line said it experienced strong post-Olympic sales trends through the month of September and remains encouraged as it approaches the holiday selling season.

Finish Line is a specialty retailer of men's, women's, and children's athletic and leisure footwear, activewear and accessories. It currently operates 238 stores in 26 states, principally in the Midwest, South and Southeast. The company's current plans call for store square footage to grow by 25 percent for the current fiscal year and by 25 percent during the subsequent fiscal year.
